quest.title: "Quiet, please, this is a library!"
quest.description: Ella Musk is trying to study in the library, but it seems something is disrupting her...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Ye ika gusha mosi!

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: My apologies... That's because the library's been so loud recently that I can't study Hilichurlian in peace.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Ever since the Windblume Festival started, there's been a great number of people hanging out here. Initially, they were keeping quiet and reading books, but then they started... chatting.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: There's more... They did a lot of terrifying things...

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Turning book corners... Sticking strange objects between the pages... They even went as far as to put books back on the shelves upside down!

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: A library is not a place for romantic rendezvous! Unless one aims to disrupt all scholars actually studying inside as intended, that is!

choices.text: Wyratt should be maintaining order in here.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: What can he do? Throwing people out won't solve the root cause of the problem.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: That's why I need to ask for your assistance. Please tell them to get a hold of themselves.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: Thank you. Those three couples over there are making the most noise. If you can make them aware of how bothersome their babbling is, I'll be able to continue my research.

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: But be careful. They're quite difficult to handle...

choices.text: I'll see what I can do.
You can bring it up with Lisa...

response.speaker: Ella Musk
response.text: But I've heard that she's currently out on patrol with the Acting Grand Master. If she were here, those couples would surely be on their best behavior...

talks.objective: Go to the library and find Ella Musk
Try and convince the lovebirds to be quiet

dialogues.speaker: Young Man in Love
dialogues.text: Such a thrilling story! It's a shame they didn't get to have their happy ending.

dialogues.speaker: Young Woman in Love
dialogues.text: We definitely won't become like them, right?

dialogues.speaker: Young Man in Love
dialogues.text: That goes without saying. Even if we were torn apart and placed in different corners of the world, I'd find a way to bring you back to me.

choices.text: You should keep quiet in the library.

response.speaker: Young Woman in Love
response.text: Huh? I've been keeping my voice low all this time.

response.speaker: Young Man in Love
response.text: *sigh* It's like in that book — an obstacle in the way of our love...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You should also put the books you've finished reading back where they belong.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look at all those books lying around in complete disarray. Somebody will have to put them back on the right shelves, and they're not gonna be happy about this mess.

response.speaker: Young Man in Love
response.text: Yeah, yeah, we got it. Could you leave us alone? You've interrupted us at a crucial moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Crucial moment...?

response.speaker: Young Woman in Love
response.text: No matter what hardships befall us, do you promise to stay the same as you are now and never change?

response.speaker: Young Man in Love
response.text: I do. I swear on my life.

response.speaker: Young Woman in Love
response.text: That seems a bit excessive... The very thought of losing you tears my heart in two.

response.speaker: Young Man in Love
response.text: Ah, your gentle nature makes me fall for you even more...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's like talking to a brick wall.

choices.text: Someone complained that you're too loud.

talks.objective: Try and convince the lovebirds to be quiet

dialogues.speaker: Besotted Woman
dialogues.text: Excuse me? Did you want something?

choices.text: You should keep quiet in the library.

response.speaker: Besotted Woman
response.text: My apologies, I'll be more mindful of that. I just can't help giving voice to my feelings sometimes.

response.speaker: Man Doing Magic Tricks
response.text: While you weren't paying attention, I drew out a rose from between the pages.

response.speaker: Man Doing Magic Tricks
response.text: This book-born rose is just like you — delicate and full of scholarly beauty...

response.speaker: Besotted Woman
response.text: Wha—!? That was amazing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're being too noisy! And books aren't meant to be used as props for magic tricks! You'll tear them apart!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You might want to keep it down too, Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, sorry. Paimon didn't mean to...

response.speaker: Besotted Woman
response.text: So now you understand. Some things are beyond our control.

response.speaker: Besotted Woman
response.text: Once again, I'm truly sorry. I'll keep my volume in check.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It doesn't seem like they took it to heart...

choices.text: Someone complained that you're too loud.

talks.objective: Try and convince the lovebirds to be quiet

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Woman
dialogues.text: You claim that "fluctuations of emotions may influence the accuracy of research and analysis"? This assertion is founded on insufficient grounds.

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Man
dialogues.text: *sigh* I understand. I must be encountering some strange hindrance to my research...

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Man
dialogues.text: You've come at the right moment. I'm having a little trouble right now, and I'd like to have your opinion on it as an outlander.

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Man
dialogues.text: If I want to prove the veracity of my logic, I must ensure that I keep my cool.

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Man
dialogues.text: But I can never do this, and especially not when I'm debating with her — I just can't seem to keep my cool and think.

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Woman
dialogues.text: I find it strange, too. Did you not sleep well last night? Or are you hungover?

choices.text: Either way, you probably shouldn't speak too loudly in the library.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Either way, you should both pipe down a bit.

response.speaker: Seemingly Rational Man
response.text: Sorry, but I won't rest until I figure this out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: H—He didn't listen at all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, you shouldn't be disturbing others either way. Also, stop putting the books back on the shelves with spines facing inward!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... They're not paying us any mind at all...

choices.text: Either way, you should both pipe down a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Guess nobody's in the mood for advice, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: None of them have very good library etiquette. Best we go talk it over with Wyratt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the racket in the library...

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: I see... I guess we'll just have to use "that method."

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Miss Lisa mentioned in the past that there will be consequences for breaking the library rules...

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Do you mind going into the library to pass Miss Lisa's message along?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Making dog-ears on pages, stuffing roses into books, putting them onto shelves the wrong way... These are definitely violations of the library rules.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, let's go pass Lisa's message on to those people in the library who aren't reading the way they should.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!? What? Lisa's coming back soon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! She'll be real mad when she finds out that people have made a mess out of the books and even dog-eared the pages, won't she?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's right — oh no, how terrible! Who will save us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, what are we to do? Oh, oh! Maybe there might still be time if we start cleaning up now!

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: That was quite ingenious of you. Quite unexpected.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That was Wyratt's idea.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, Lisa's reputation precedes her.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Still, Miss Lisa probably would have been mad if she had seen the state the library was in earlier. This is a library, after all — a place of learning.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Guess I can finally continue my research in peace. Here, take this as thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: The main hall of the Knights of Favonius Headquarters. Please keep noise to a minimum.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Please wipe your shoes before entering the Library to avoid taking any dust or dirt inside.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Goodbye. Don't forget to close the door behind you when you leave.

dialogues.speaker: Ella Musk
dialogues.text: Please lend me a hand, I really need some peace and quiet...

dialogues.speaker: Young Man in Love
dialogues.text: Let's read this one next. Would you like me to read it to you?

dialogues.speaker: Young Woman in Love
dialogues.text: Of course. I love hearing you tell stories.

dialogues.speaker: Man Doing Magic Tricks
dialogues.text: And what shall my next trick be? No need to tell me, just let me read your mind...

dialogues.speaker: Besotted Woman
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm so nervous...

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Man
dialogues.text: What's the matter, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: Seemingly Rational Woman
dialogues.text: If there's nothing else, let's discuss the other contents of this research.
